aboutPage.title: About Drive KKTC
aboutPage.content: Drive KKTC is an independent, premium tourism initiative designed to help travelers discover the natural beauty, history, and culinary secrets of Northern Cyprus. Encouraging slow travel and self-driven road trips, our routes guide you off the beaten path, from the medieval castle peaks of Girne to the wild, golden shores of Karpaz.
aboutPage.rule1: Keep Left: In Cyprus, traffic drives on the left side of the road, similar to the United Kingdom.
aboutPage.rule2: Seatbelts & Phones: Seatbelts are mandatory for all passengers. Using a mobile phone while driving is strictly illegal.
aboutPage.rule3: Signposts: Major destination names are in Turkish, with distance markers in kilometers.
aboutPage.rule4: Border Crossing: Rental cars rented in the South cannot be taken to the North without buying separate third-party insurance at the border crossing.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. Learn how we handle your data.
privacyPage.p1: Drive KKTC operates as an independent informational guide. We do not collect, store, or sell personal tracking data or private identity records.
privacyPage.p2: Any user preferences, such as language or theme selections, are stored locally on your device via browser local storage.
privacyPage.p3: If you have any questions regarding privacy, please feel free to reach out via our contact page.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.subtitle: Terms and conditions for using Drive KKTC guides and route maps.
termsPage.p1: Drive KKTC provides driving route suggestions and travel recommendations for informational and entertainment purposes only.
termsPage.p2: Drivers must adhere strictly to local traffic laws, speed limits, and road safety regulations in Northern Cyprus at all times.
termsPage.p3: We accept no liability for road conditions, traffic incidents, closure of third-party venues, or weather disruptions.

homePage.editorialSubtitle: Our routes are built for travelers who appreciate the freedom of self-driven discovery. From the medieval ramparts of crusader castles overlooking Kyrenia, to the wind-swept golden coastlines of Karpaz, we show you the true heart of Northern Cyprus.
